title: Grade 2 French — Thu, Jun 12
description: Les animaux — Day 4 of 5: Animal sounds and body parts
subject: french

questions.question: What sound does a dog make in French? 'Le chien ___.'
questions.explanation: 'Le chien aboie.' = The dog barks. 'Aboyer' = to bark. Animal sound verbs are fun to learn!

questions.question: What sound does a cat make in French? 'Le chat ___.'
questions.explanation: 'Le chat miaule.' = The cat meows. 'Miauler' = to meow.

questions.question: What sound does a cow make in French? 'La vache ___.'
questions.explanation: 'La vache meugle.' = The cow moos. 'Meugler' = to moo.

questions.question: What sound does a lion make in French? 'Le lion ___.'
questions.explanation: 'Le lion rugit.' = The lion roars. 'Rugir' = to roar.

questions.question: What does 'une patte' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Une patte' = a paw or leg (of an animal). 'Le chien a quatre pattes.' = The dog has four paws/legs.

questions.question: What is 'une queue' in English (for an animal)?
questions.explanation: 'Une queue' = a tail. 'Le chat a une longue queue.' = The cat has a long tail. (Note: 'queue' in French also means a queue/line of people!)

questions.question: What is 'des plumes' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Des plumes' = feathers. 'L'oiseau a des plumes colorées.' = The bird has colourful feathers.

questions.question: What is 'des écailles' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Des écailles' = scales. 'Le poisson a des écailles.' = The fish has scales.

questions.question: Complete: 'Un chien a quatre ___ et une ___.' (A dog has four paws and a tail.)
questions.explanation: 'Un chien a quatre pattes et une queue.' = A dog has four paws and a tail. Pattes = paws/legs; queue = tail.

questions.question: What does a fish use to swim? 'Le poisson nage avec ses ___.'
questions.explanation: 'Le poisson nage avec ses nageoires.' = The fish swims with its fins. 'Nageoires' = fins.

questions.question: What is 'un bec' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Un bec' = a beak. 'L'oiseau a un bec pour manger.' = The bird has a beak for eating.

questions.question: True or False: Birds have 'des pattes' (legs).
questions.explanation: True! Birds have both 'des ailes' (wings) AND 'des pattes' (legs/feet). 'L'oiseau a des ailes et des pattes.' = The bird has wings and legs.

questions.question: Match: lion / chat / vache with their sounds:
questions.explanation: Lion → rugit (roars); chat → miaule (meows); vache → meugle (moos). Each animal has its own French sound verb.

questions.question: How do you say 'The elephant has big ears' in French?
questions.explanation: 'L'éléphant a de grandes oreilles.' = The elephant has big ears. 'De grandes' = big (feminine plural before grandes).

questions.question: Week review: which animal body part is 'des plumes' found on?
questions.explanation: 'Des plumes' (feathers) are found on birds (les oiseaux). Fish have 'des écailles' (scales); dogs have 'de la fourrure' (fur).
